messages:
Nora L: FYI incoming from Sales  MunicipalHealth wants special pilot pricing + Net60 terms. They missed PO window and asked for a one-time invoice credit to cover procurement delay.
Sam W: Theyre a strategic public-sector pilot; potential to expand across city health systems. Request: 30% credit on first-month usage ($9,000 of $30,000), plus Net60 payment terms moving forward for pilot invoices.
Priya M: Need criteria: 1) validate pipeline / expansion potential 2) risk of precedent 3) GL & approval owner. Do we have exec sponsor?
Sam W: Exec sponsor: VP Partnerships (Marc G). Sales ops attached opportunity OPP-9981 with forecasted $600k ARR over 18 months if pilot converts. procure-bot: attached procurement note.
procure-bot: <https://procurement.redwood.com/req/MH-455|MH-455>  shows PO delayed due to municipal review cycle, expected signing in 45 days.
Iris K: Legal: Net60 is OK for public entities with signed PO. For the credit, we need a non-precedent clause and clawback if customer cancels within 90 days.
Priya M: Finance view: we can consider a structured concession: 25% credit now ($7,500) instead of 30%, plus Net60 for pilot invoices, conditioned on (A) signed pilot MOU within 7 days, (B) SFDC opportunity update with expansion milestones, (C) clawback clause for 90 days. Also require GL code ADJ-PUB-01.
Nora L: Can we cap the concession exposure? Suggest cap $8k. Also require customer to accept a reduced support SLA during pilot (no premium SRE hours included).
Sam W: Customer accepted SLA change verbally; will get MOU signed. Sales will attach MOU to OPP-9981 and tag Marc G as sponsor.
Iris K: Approval note: Approved one-time credit of 25% on first-month usage ($7,500), cap $8,000. Conditions: signed MOU within 7 days, SFDC addendum, 90-day clawback clause, GL ADJ-PUB-01. Approver: Iris K. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Created provisional credit memo CM-2028-7701 (status: pending), GL: ADJ-PUB-01.
Priya M: Please record in Deal Desk tracker and mark as "public-sector concession" precedent. Finance to release credit after MOU is attached and PO in progress.
Nora L: I'll notify customer and update invoice comments. Closing loop once CM is posted. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
